measurement: Three fixed-clock, fixed-cycle supplementary diagnostic runs. The combined envelope is reconstructed from adjacent theme and content-layout timestamp segments.

interpretation.segment: The themeApplication segment brackets the two ApplyThemePalette calls; contentLayout brackets page-host assignment, responsive layout and UpdateLayout. These are WPF operation timings from the test harness.
interpretation.gc: GC.CollectionCount deltas are operation-window counters, not exact collection timestamps. Correlation is descriptive, not causal.
interpretation.overlap: Rendering callback gaps overlap operation time ranges; they are not physical/presented frames and temporal overlap is not proof of causation.
interpretation.comparison: The composite envelope approximates the older single layout timing boundary. Current U00 original frame/total-allocation baseline remains unavailable, so this does not complete the acceptance comparison.
interpretation.input: Programmatic fake-data text updates are not physical keyboard or IME response.
interpretation.host: The opacity 0.01 controlled STA window is not Playnite host rendering.
